map.该条 start=5000ms、end=8500ms。①整体提前 0.5 秒：偏: This cue has start=5000ms, end=8500ms. (1) Shift the whole file 0.5 seconds earlier: offset −500ms, multiplier 1 → start=4500ms (00:00:04,500), end=8000ms (00:00:08,000). (2) Convert 25fps to 24fps: speed multiplier 25/24≈1.0417 → start=5000×1.0417≈5208ms (00:00:05,208), end=8500×1.0417≈8854ms (00:00:08,854). (3) Combined (offset −500 + multiplier 1.0417): start≈4708ms (00:00:04,708), end≈8354ms (00:00:08,354). The tool formula is newTime = origTime × multiplier + offset(ms), scaling first and then shifting.
map.SRT 与 WebVTT 的: The difference between SRT and WebVTT
map.SRT 用逗号分隔毫秒（HH:MM:SS,mmm），WebVTT 用点号（HH:: SRT separates milliseconds with a comma (HH:MM:SS,mmm), while WebVTT uses a period (HH:MM:SS.mmm) and requires a WEBVTT file header; SRT is used mainly for external subtitles, and VTT is the format natively supported by HTML5 <video>. This tool converts between them in one click, with no manual separator editing.
